candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner, so owner() always returns address(0).
Return the caller (msg.sender) instead of the stored owner.
Return tx.origin instead of the stored owner.
Remove the _checkOwner() call so onlyOwner no longer restricts the caller, allowing anyone to transfer ownership.
Delete the require that rejects the zero address so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
Delete the _transferOwnership call so the owner is never changed and no OwnershipTransferred event fires.
Replace the zero-address check with a check forbidding transfer to the current owner, making self-transfers revert.
Delete the require that blocks the zero address, so updateRoundImplementation can set roundImplementation to address(0).
Replace the assignment so roundImplementation is always set to address(0) instead of the new value.
Change the require to demand the zero address, so any non-zero update reverts and roundImplementation keeps its old value.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can pass, allowing non-owners to change roundImplementation and blocking the owner.
Remove the ownership check from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call updateRoundImplementation and change roundImplementation.
